threat_event: Attacker uses stolen cloud or pipeline credentials to read customer data across many tenants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 46,000 non-human identities; long-lived keys in 9 legacy OCP pipelines and 31 in AQ-01; 212 live secrets found in 2026 H1; no bulk-read alert on exports
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-05; SYS-09; customer data of about 9,800 customers
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)); N51-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05); state breach laws; Customer DPA
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for workforce; PAM; workload identities for most services; secret scanning; 24x7 SOC
treatment_plan: Remove long-lived keys and revoke live secrets (POAM-002); bulk-read and export detections (POAM-003); minimize and re-scope the AQ-01 export (POAM-001); annual exercise with the disclosure committee (2026-11-12)
key_risk_indicator: Long-lived keys remaining; median days to revoke a found secret; bulk-read alerts tested

threat_event: A leaked AQ-01 CI access key is used through the cross-account role to copy the shared export of Operations Cloud transcripts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AQ-01 static keys older than one year; publicly readable CI build logs (R-058); broad cross-account read of the whole export bucket; AQ-01 logs not in the SIEM
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-09 shared export bucket; transcripts and case exports of 1,150 shared customers
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)); Customer DPA; Fla. Stat. 501.171(6); N51-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05)
existing_controls: Export encrypted at rest; AQ-01 engineers use MFA on their own identity provider
treatment_plan: Scope the role to one prefix per customer and minimize exports (POAM-001); remove AQ-01 static keys and federate (POAM-002); onboard AQ-01 logs (POAM-003); guardrails for AQ-01 (POAM-019)
key_risk_indicator: AQ-01 static keys remaining; export bucket principals with read access

threat_event: Attacker moves from the AQ-01 cloud organization into the OCP through the integration path

threat_event: A support or operations engineer opens a customer tenant without need and views or exports data

key_risk_indicator: Share of sessions recorded; sessions without a ticket; customer-approved sessions
